name: 341. Cohere Responses usage reports billed units (cohere responses billed units)
description: TXE-6986. Cohere through /v1/responses settles on billed_units like chat (folder 323): when billed_units carries input and output tokens they fill input_tokens and output_tokens, and the processed usage.tokens go to usage.processed_tokens{prompt_tokens, completion_tokens}, the same object as on chat usage. The streamed response.completed maps the same way (Go tests in core/providers/cohere).
